title: The old man from the shrine

cues.text: Outside the dorm, you sit on the front steps, Koromaru sitting on the pavement beside you. A few passers-by walk along the street.
An old man in a flat cap, a full plastic shopping bag in each hand, walks slowly up the street and stops in front of Koromaru.
The old man sits down on the steps beside you and sets his two bags at his feet.
You get up from the steps and go to the old man, who stands bent over beside his bags.
Later, back in front of the dorm, Koromaru trots beside you. Fuuka and Aigis, school bags in hand, come over to meet you both, and you crouch down beside Koromaru.
